ops.name: capabilities_get
ops.title: Describe this player
ops.description: Capability manifest: ops with input schemas, loaded packs, limits, embedder, a2a settings.

ops.name: pack_load
ops.title: Load a pack
ops.description: Load a pack from a store key, path or URL through the host adapter. Optional expect{} pins agent, model, dim or version and refuses on mismatch.

ops.name: pack_verify
ops.title: Verify a pack
ops.description: Run the integrity checks LP-V01..LP-V18. Returns one check object per line-able entry.

ops.name: pack_stats
ops.title: Pack statistics
ops.description: Counts, processing status, edge origin mix, top predicates, disconnected entity groups.

ops.name: sources_list
ops.title: List sources
ops.description: One row per source file: chunks, edges, chunks without edges, first and last ingest time.

ops.name: vectors_search
ops.title: Semantic search
ops.description: Cosine top-k over the pack vectors. Query by text (needs an embedder in the pack model), by a vector with its model, or like_id. Never falls back to keywords.

ops.name: text_search
ops.title: Keyword search
ops.description: Case-insensitive substring search over chunk text and edge s/r/o. Modes all, any, phrase. Deterministic.

ops.name: graph_traverse
ops.title: Graph walk
ops.description: k-hop walk (max 3) over the entity graph from start entities or a chunk. Heuristic edges excluded unless asked.

ops.name: record_get
ops.title: Get a record
ops.description: One record by id. Vectors come with their edges; edges come with their source chunk.

ops.name: peer_ask
ops.title: Ask another agent
ops.description: Send a query to another agent's player in an a2a envelope. Subject to the target's exposure policy, loop and hop limits.
